child.chipA11y: A new experience for your pup. Still open this week.
child.title: A new experience
child.intro: Puppies learn about the world through new experiences. This week, show your pup something new. What will it be?
child.pick: Once your pup has had it, tap your choice.
child.tip: Go slowly and praise a lot. If your pup gets scared, step back and try another day.
child.success: Well done! Your pup discovered something new.

person.label: A new person
person.hint: Your pup meets someone new – a neighbour, grandma or a friend.

dog.label: Another dog
dog.hint: Your pup calmly says hello to another friendly dog.

sound.label: A new sound
sound.hint: Your pup hears something new – a vacuum cleaner, the doorbell or rain on the window.

place.label: A new place
place.hint: Your pup visits a new place – a park, a new street or a car ride.
